'''Dusty''' was a [[Gender/Legends|man]], who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Dusty worked as a courier for the criminal [[Vex (Human)|Vex]]. During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Dusty was among a group of couriers that were sent by Vex to collect an illicit cargo, in the jungles of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. Dusty flew to the rendezvous point where they would be collecting the cargo, on a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]]. When they arrived, there was no-one else there and Dusty kept checking his [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], to see if anyone was trying to contact them. However, they were amushed by a group of enforcers that were working for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Riboga]]. Dusty was shot in the face, killing him instantly.
